conditions: The scope is the begin-block forms described by the IBM reference.
limitations: The reference separately allows a transfer to a labeled BEGIN via GO TO. Procedure calls, block termination, optimization options, and cross-edition behavior have separate rules.

statement: The IBM 6.1 reference delimits a begin-block with BEGIN and its matching END. It describes activation by sequential control flow or as a unit in an IF, ON, WHEN, or OTHERWISE statement.
